source_facts.fact: Updated safeguarding directions were published 30 June 2026 to reflect revised April 2026 proposals and require relevant LPAs to refer applications within safeguarded land to East West Rail Company for comment.
source_facts.gate: Safeguarded land is not automatically acquired and referral is not automatic refusal.

source_facts.fact: HS2 developer guidance was updated 25 March 2026 and uses safeguarding maps to determine whether HS2 Ltd should be consulted on affected planning applications.
source_facts.gate: HS2 safeguarding is not planning permission, compulsory acquisition or certain construction.

source_facts.fact: DfT guidance updated 18 February 2026 describes a Transport and Works Act order as the usual route for authorising new railway or tramway schemes in England and Wales.
source_facts.gate: TWA application or consultation is not an order made.

source_facts.fact: ORR states it is a statutory consultee for planning applications likely to affect the rail transport industry and aims to respond to directly rail-related consultations within 20 working days.
source_facts.gate: ORR consultation response is not the planning authority decision.

source_facts.fact: Network Rail Asset Protection and Optimisation provides railway safety assurance and support for activities on or near the railway.
source_facts.gate: ASPRO engagement is not planning permission or an asset-protection agreement itself.

source_facts.fact: Condition 17 of Network Rail's licence safeguards against inappropriate disposal of land important to continuing operation or future development of the railway.
source_facts.gate: A disposal case or ORR consent does not establish parcel development permission or availability.

core_rules: rail safeguarding direction is not planning permission
safeguarded land is not automatically compulsorily acquired
safeguarding boundary is not a Land Registry title boundary
planning referral within safeguarding is not automatic refusal
project company comment is not the local planning authority final decision
statutory blight eligibility is not automatic compensation entitlement
blight notice submitted is not blight notice accepted
property scheme guidance is not a valuation conclusion
HS2 safeguarding map must retain phase and update date
removed or revised HS2 safeguarding must not be reported from superseded maps
East West Rail safeguarding must use the current 30 June 2026 direction where applicable
EWR safeguarding reflects project proposals and is not construction commencement
Crossrail 2 historic safeguarding material must be date-scoped
safeguarding does not necessarily prevent all other development
accommodation of safeguarded infrastructure can require design changes but does not guarantee approval
TWA application is not a TWA order made
TWA order made is not proof construction has commenced
TWA authorisation and planning permission routes must not be conflated
TWA decision letter must be matched to the correct scheme
TWA consultation representation is not project approval or refusal
ORR statutory consultation is not the planning authority decision
ORR 20-working-day response aim is not a statutory planning determination deadline
ORR planning role must remain distinct from rail safety regulation
Network Rail ASPRO enquiry is not asset-protection agreement
asset-protection agreement is not planning permission
ASPRO safety assurance is not proof development is buildable
working near railway requires project-specific interface evidence
railway proximity is not proof of unsafe development
operational railway boundary must not be guessed from track centreline
railway land ownership must not be inferred from visible fencing
Network Rail land disposal case is not parcel availability for development
ORR land disposal consent is not planning permission
Condition 17 protects public-interest railway needs and is not a site allocation
historic land disposal consent does not prove current ownership
rail infrastructure future-development need is not a guaranteed funded scheme
Safer Railway Scheme accreditation is not planning approval
rail safety accreditation is not land-use planning consent
station or railway safeguarding policy is not passenger-capacity evidence
rail service proximity is not evidence of service frequency or capacity
future rail project announcement is not safeguarded status unless directions exist
consultation route is not final route alignment
safeguarded route is not proof every mapped property will be acquired
compulsory purchase powers if granted are not proof acquisition has completed
railway development can require other environmental and planning consents separately
project safeguarding and Network Rail operational asset protection must remain distinct
NO_DATA must not be converted into no rail constraint
no parcel acquisition outcome railway approval or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
research-source confidence must not be reported as parcel rail accuracy
